title: Synthetic peptide NX-3 versus placebo for sleep latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial
items.abstract: We conducted a double-blind randomized controlled trial in 124 adults (aged 18-65) with chronic insomnia. Participants received NX-3 or placebo for 4 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep latency measured by polysomnography. NX-3 significantly reduced sleep latency compared with placebo.

title: NX-3 for pediatric insomnia: a randomized placebo-controlled trial in children aged 6-12
items.abstract: This randomized placebo-controlled trial enrolled 88 children aged 6-12 years with insomnia. Participants received NX-3 or placebo for 6 weeks. Sleep latency was assessed by actigraphy. The study population was exclusively pediatric.

title: NX-3 in chronic insomnia: a randomized placebo-controlled pilot study
items.abstract: In this pilot randomized placebo-controlled study, 40 adults with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was the primary endpoint. The trial was conducted in 2011 and published in 2012.

title: NX-3 versus placebo in patients aged 16 to 65 with chronic insomnia: a randomized trial
items.abstract: We randomized 150 participants aged 16 to 65 years with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was measured by sleep diaries and actigraphy over 8 weeks.

title: NX-3 versus placebo on sleep onset latency in adults with chronic insomnia: a multicenter randomized controlled trial
items.abstract: This multicenter randomized controlled trial randomly assigned 240 adults with chronic insomnia to NX-3 or matching placebo for 6 weeks. The primary outcome was sleep onset latency measured by polysomnography. NX-3 shortened sleep onset latency versus placebo.

title: Effects of NX-3 versus placebo on sleep latency in older adults with chronic insomnia: a randomized controlled trial
items.abstract: In a randomized controlled trial, 96 older adults (aged 60-80) with chronic insomnia received NX-3 or placebo. Sleep latency was assessed by polysomnography at baseline and week 4. NX-3 improved sleep latency relative to placebo.
